items.title: Elon Musk spends half his time talking robots and AI on Tesla earnings calls
items.summary: An analysis of the last seven years of Tesla earnings calls shows just little attention Musk pays to Tesla's car business.

items.title: Intesa Sanpaolo slashed IBIT stake by 94% in 2Q, tripled ether ETF holding as crypto prices slumped
items.summary: Its iShares Staked Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHB) stake tripled to 349,600 shares as long bitcoin ETF holdings fell 35% in value to $69.3 million.
items.titleZh: 由于加密货币价格暴跌，联合圣保罗银行在第二季度将IBIT的股份削减了94%，以太ETF的持有量增加了两倍
items.summaryZh: 其持有的iShares以太坊信托ETF（ETHB）股份增加了两倍，达到349600股，而长期比特币ETF的价值下跌了35%，至6930万美元。

items.title: Can your tax preparer use AI without telling you? Some experts say IRS rules aren't clear
items.summary: A debate is brewing among tax practitioners regarding whether using AI to prepare tax returns should require a disclosure to clients.
items.titleZh: 你的税务筹划人可以在不告诉你的情况下使用人工智能吗？一些专家表示，美国国税局的规定并不明确
items.summaryZh: 税务从业者之间正在酝酿一场争论，即使用人工智能准备纳税申报表是否需要向客户披露。
